pages.title: SOLAR
pages.text: The $(item)Solar Weather$() program shows the $(l:radiocraft:propagation/solar_weather)solar weather$(): the conditions and the noise floor, each HF band now, by day and by night, VHF and the aurora, sporadic E, and the next spell once it is known, with a blackout warning in red.$(br2)Tab turns to the $(thing)forecast$(): the weather where the computer is, the days ahead and the storms about.

Like the Teletype's SOLAR WX, the computer has to hear these: wire it to a powered radio with a real antenna (it copies the geophysical alert and weather broadcasts), or to an $(l:radiocraft:sky/ionosphere)Ionospheric Processor$(). Servers can drop that need (solar_weather_station_needs_radio).$(br2)Both pages refresh every 20 seconds. F6 prints the page as a book, F7 saves it as a text file.
A blank floppy and a daylight detector.
